title: Kenyan Chickpea Fritters with Zesty Dipping Sauce
description: Crispy Kenyan-style fritters filled with chickpeas, served with a tangy zesty dipping sauce. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl, mix together chickpeas, flour, zesty sauce, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
When the oil is hot, add a few fritters to the pan (do not overcrowd).
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot with additional zesty sauce for dipping.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining fritters.
